tables.name: Lifestyle
tables.description: How the leader goes about their life. Rolled once here; with several leaders, roll again for each (the number of leaders is yours to choose). Modifies Residence.

results.name: Humble
results.description: The leader requires only what is necessary to live and function basically. Minimal attention is paid to their comfort. (-6 to residence roll)

results.name: Respectable
results.description: The leader’s lifestyle is unassuming, but comfortable, appropriate to one in their position. (+0 to residence roll)

results.name: Distinguished
results.description: The leader aspires to quality and high-functionality, but without concern for needless luxury or vanity. (+0 to residence roll)

results.name: Exquisite
results.description: The leader quietly enjoys the luxuries afforded to one in their lofty position, and presents a refined, well-maintained appearance. (+1 to residence roll)

results.name: Luxurious
results.description: The leader takes unrestrained advantage of the comforts and luxuries available to one in their position, and presents a striking, or flamboyant, appearance. (+2 to residence roll)

results.name: Ostentatious
results.description: The leader revels in comfort and luxury, probably to excess, or endeavours to project such an image. They aim to inspire awe and jealousy in all who see them. (+3 to residence roll)
